about: The sample nights the app opens with no photo of the person's own (first-use-sample-one, DECIDED-BY-LEAD 25 Nov 03:22 and 03:43). Each names a public photo as the corpus photos come (its entry in data/downloads.json, fetched from its own recorded source and nothing else), its credit and licence, and where on this machine the app's own solve of it is kept with its SHA-256 beside it. The solution is never tracked and never cut: the app's own solver makes it at setup or on the first press. Read by services/contracts/samples.py and packages/contracts/src/samples.ts.
